question.text: Under IFSCA guidelines, what is the general/default periodicity for updation of Customer Due Diligence (CDD) for a LOW-RISK customer (other than resident Indian customers with an existing Financial Group relationship)?

explanation.text: The Logic: The general CDD updation periodicity is annual for high-risk customers, once in three years for medium-risk customers, and once in every five years for low-risk customers. The five-year answer applies to low-risk customers under this general framework. The Trap: Annual is the periodicity for high-risk customers; once in three years is for medium-risk customers. Longer periodicities apply only to the separate category of resident Indian customers with an existing Financial Group relationship. Note: The general pattern for non-Financial-Group customers is 1 year / 3 years / 5 years for high/medium/low risk.
